required_mounts.decomp: the pret/pokefirered checkout, the directory holding firered.sha1 and src/ (this repo's gitignored decompiled/)
required_mounts.deps: the prebuilt toolchain tree, the .box/deps directory that tools/host-prep.sh fills in (it holds a .frlg-deps marker)
required_mounts.artifacts: writable scratch that outlives a sandbox, the directory holding a .frlg-artifacts marker that tools/host-prep.sh creates; must be given as PATH:rw
